title: Ultimate Sakapatate - Act 1 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Ultimate Sakapatate in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 1, Ancient Sanctuary.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Ultimate Sakapatate is an Act 1 fight in the Ancient Sanctuary built around a giant shield. It is the earliest boss where you are asked to deal with a guard mechanic rather than just output damage.

sections.title: Where to Find the Ultimate Sakapatate
sections.content: Location: Ancient Sanctuary, Act 1. It also reappears in The Monolith, the Endless Tower and the Endless Night Sanctuary, so the same weakness applies whenever you meet it.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances

Fire is the only element that lands on Ultimate Sakapatate, and the shield means you need to get through its guard before Fire damage matters.

sections.title: How to Beat the Ultimate Sakapatate
sections.content:
Break the guard first

Ultimate Sakapatate carries a shield and a red mace. While the shield is up, your damage is going somewhere other than its health bar. Break effects and multi-hit Fire skills are the efficient route.

Fire is the key

Nothing else lands cleanly. Every Fire-skilled character you have should be in the party, and Fire-infused weapons are worth the swap even if they are a tier lower.

  • Fire only - everything else is a waste of a turn.
  • Strip the shield before you try to burst it down.
  • It re-appears later with the same profile, so the answer does not change.
